stem:
Use “Millennials. . . So Happy Together” and “The Leper’s Squint” to answer the following question.

In the excerpt from “The Leper’s Squint,” how is Desmond’s opinion about his current situation different from how Millennials feel about co-living in the excerpt from the article “Millennials. . . So Happy Together”?

options.label: F
options.text: Desmond is irritated that his family is sharing his workspace.

options.label: G
options.text: Desmond is bothered by sharing a home with a stranger.

options.label: H
options.text: Desmond is curious to experience co-living in another country.

options.label: J
options.text: Desmond is relieved to be co-living in a home for a short time.
